scope: All32 complete original/native/four-orbit/four-street sheets were individually inspected. Scores4/5 are structural screenings, not aesthetic approval. Every source/orbit/street/world/states/consistency acceptance gate remains false.

river_bank_slope_study_temperate_se_edge.defect: The shallow falling native bank and eight-unit original slope are recognizable, but its pale sediment toe is too broad, the dark-green near shoulder is underfilled and the longitudinal cuts/side paint remain regular.
The original broad dark-green lower shoulder and pale upper margin become a very narrow green cap with an overexposed pale lower return; the near endpoint and longitudinal outline are wrong.

river_bank_slope_study_temperate_ne_edge.defect: The steep rising native owner retains its direction, but the source's wide dark-green body and fine pale left rim are replaced by a thin green centre and thick stepped pale margins.
The pale-front/green-rear steep bank is recognizable, but the native lower tip and soil lobe widths differ from the source, with excessively regular toe shelves and side courses.

river_bank_slope_study_temperate_sw_edge.defect: The particular sea-level source has a broad dark-green bank with an orange/pale beach junction, while this bank-only volume is too narrow and lacks that bank-owned beach transition; the independent original wave fringe remains undecomposed, not masked away.

The sea-level green/pale near bank is underfilled, with a pale toe that is too uniform and no accurate orange/beige bank tip at the original wave junction. The original blue fringe stays separately retained and unaccepted.

river_bank_slope_study_temperate_nw_edge.defect: The steep descending owner retains the correct broad direction and pale near rim, but original turf mounds, bright-green flecks and the broad lower endpoint are flattened into a narrow regular crest.
The original broad bright-green rear shoulder is strongly underfilled and its pale upper border becomes a pale-dominated strip; source endpoint lobes and green/light side shades are inaccurate.

river_bank_slope_study_arctic_se_edge00.defect: The ordinary brown/olive bank has the right shallow slope, but the pale sediment skirt is too wide and the original dark-brown upper shoulder and olive fleck distribution are simplified.

river_bank_slope_study_arctic_se_edge02.defect: The original brown/olive lower mass is reduced to a thin dark cap above repeated light sediment, losing the pale upper margin and the compact uneven endpoint.

river_bank_slope_study_arctic_ne_edge01.defect: The steep Arctic bank is too pale and narrow, with insufficient brown/olive body and exaggerated sediment margins compared with the original broad mottled shoulder.

river_bank_slope_study_arctic_ne_edge03.defect: The ordinary brown-rear/pale-front order is recognizable, but the source's lumpy light toe and unequal brown crest are reduced to regular stepped sections and overbright side patches.

river_bank_slope_study_arctic_sw_edge01.defect: This actually elevated ordinary Arctic owner, unlike the other climates' observed SW shore source, is too thin and pale; its original broad brown/olive belly and pale upper rim are not retained.

river_bank_slope_study_arctic_sw_edge03.defect: The elevated shallow rising bank has the correct brown/pale arrangement, but its native belly/bright central rim are underfilled and the original brown end taper is too angular and uniformly coursed.

river_bank_slope_study_arctic_nw_edge00.defect: The descending ordinary brown/olive and pale owner is recognizable, but it lacks the source's broad mottled cap, light irregular side notches and fuller lower tip.

river_bank_slope_study_arctic_nw_edge02.defect: The original broad pale/olive rear shoulder becomes a thin dark-brown strip with simplified pale edges; its green flecks, light upper margin and endpoint mass remain wrong.

river_bank_slope_study_tropic_se_edge00.defect: The muted-green shallow falling bank has the expected broad direction, but the pale sediment toe is too wide and the original turf mottling and unequal end caps remain simplified.

river_bank_slope_study_tropic_se_edge02.defect: The original muted-green near mass and pale upper shoulder are underfilled and misdistributed, leaving a narrow green crest and overly prominent light lower shelf.

river_bank_slope_study_tropic_ne_edge01.defect: The steep muted-green body is too narrow and pale, with stepped bright margins rather than the original wider green body and fine irregular upper rim.

river_bank_slope_study_tropic_ne_edge03.defect: The muted-green rear and pale near order is readable, but the source's lower cap contour, green shoulder width and scattered face shades are still reduced to a regular thin bank.

river_bank_slope_study_tropic_sw_edge01.defect: The particular sea-level owner lacks the original bank's broad muted-green lower mass and orange/pale beach transition; its independent blue/white wave fringe remains original and is not a source-comparison exemption.

river_bank_slope_study_tropic_sw_edge03.defect: The shore bank's muted-green crest is too narrow and the pale toe too regular, omitting the original warm beach tip adjacent to its retained independent wave fringe.

river_bank_slope_study_tropic_nw_edge00.defect: The steep muted-green/pale descending owner is coherent, but the native grass cap and rounded source endpoint are underfilled and the low pale side/course paint remains overregular.

river_bank_slope_study_tropic_nw_edge02.defect: The original broad light-muted-green rear mass is greatly reduced, with a pale-heavy strip replacing its upper light rim and rounded green lower tip.

river_bank_slope_study_toyland_se_edge00.defect: The yellow cap and separate pale regions are present, but the white top-only patches are too stark and rectangular, missing the original warm mottled pale side returns and ochre shoulder width.

river_bank_slope_study_toyland_se_edge02.defect: The original broad ochre body and rounded warm pale patches become a thin bright-yellow line with white top strips and insufficient pale side ownership; exposed soil still dominates the street ends.

river_bank_slope_study_toyland_ne_edge01.defect: The steep ochre/pale source is underfilled and too bright, with two flat white cap strips instead of softly shaded warm pale lobes returning down the yellow shoulder.

river_bank_slope_study_toyland_ne_edge03.defect: The yellow/pale order is recognizable, but the native cap is too narrow, pale regions too stark and the original ochre ends and pale side gradients are not reproduced.

river_bank_slope_study_toyland_sw_edge01.defect: The particular sea-level bank loses the original broad warm yellow/pale belly and soft pale return at the beach/wave junction; narrow white top strips are not those source lobes, and the independent cyan fringe remains unaccepted.

river_bank_slope_study_toyland_sw_edge03.defect: The shore bank's ochre body and large warm pale side patches are underfilled by a thin yellow line and bright white caps; the original cyan fringe remains separate, not painted onto voxels or removed from comparison.

river_bank_slope_study_toyland_nw_edge00.defect: The descending yellow/pale arrangement is coherent but its warm source lobes and full pale front return become narrow stark white top regions with an overly regular soil shelf.

river_bank_slope_study_toyland_nw_edge02.defect: The broad yellow rear owner and two rounded warm pale masses are reduced to a much narrower bright-yellow strip; white top-only patches, pale side coverage and the lower tip contour remain inaccurate.
